summary: Human-eye walkthrough of the new LP trade-spec dropdowns (panel-size, wrap-trim-width, fascia-width, batten-spacing) on the Jon Casile lp_smart estimate. Backend is green (10/10 pytest, incl. PUT bounds 422 for panel_size='4x12' and wrap_trim_width_in=5; PUT+materialize renames 38 Series 4' x 10' Panel -> 4' x 8' Panel and lifts qty 68 -> 84 (~40/32); 540 Series wrap trim 5/4" x 4" -> 5/4" x 6" NAME-ONLY (qty 62 -> 62); 440 Series fascia -> 4/4" x 12"; no fractional qtys). FRONTEND SILENT-STRIP BUG CONFIRMED: the four selects update React state (UI shows the picked value in the moment) but the autosave PUT payload does NOT include panel_size, wrap_trim_width_in, fascia_width_in, batten_spacing_in. Network trace of a UI select_option shows exactly one PUT /api/estimates/{id} whose body has customer_name, address, waste_pct, overhang_in, porch_ceilings, colors, tax, margin, lines, misc, openings, photos, status_label, install_method, home_pre_1978 -- and NOTHING for the four new trade specs. Server GET immediately after four UI flips still returns {panel_size:'4x10', wrap_trim_width_in:4, fascia_width_in:8, batten_spacing_in:12}. Reopen-the-estimate reload shows all four selects back at defaults. This is precisely the 'silent PUT strip / pytest-green / browser-broken' pattern Howard has been burned by 4 times.

ui_bugs.issue: SILENT-STRIP: PUT /api/estimates/{id} payload whitelist omits panel_size, wrap_trim_width_in, fascia_width_in, batten_spacing_in. React state updates so the UI 'looks right', but reload restores defaults and materialize/rebuild never sees the new spec. Also missing from the whitelist and therefore vulnerable: shake_reveal_in and color_tier (SettingsRow writes them via the same update() path).

integration_issues.issue: Silent strip: UI drops the four specs before hitting PUT; server GET after change shows defaults; reload shows defaults; LP tab line names / counts never re-derive from the picked spec in the browser flow. Backend materialize + PUT via API works perfectly (backend test 10/10 green); the gap is 100% in buildPayload.

reproduction: 1. Log in as hhunt6677@yahoo.com (ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env)
2. Contractor Quotes -> LP SmartSide -> open Jon Casile (id e2ce35b8-95ea-4dbc-89c9-f7a7a5c34170)
4. Observe network: exactly one PUT /api/estimates/{id} fires. Body contains customer_name, waste_pct, overhang_in, ... but does NOT contain 'panel_size'
6. Reload estimate -> select shows 4x10 (default). Same for wrap_trim_width_in, fascia_width_in, batten_spacing_in
rca_of_the_issue.why: buildPayload is a strict field whitelist. It was extended for overhang_in, porch_ceilings, color pickers, tax, margin, install_method, home_pre_1978 -- but the four new LP trade-spec fields (and also shake_reveal_in, color_tier, lp_soffit_type) were never added. React state updates so the UI 'looks right', but the autosave PUT drops them and the reload / materialize / vinyl-tab-recalc never sees them.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation:
Add the missing fields to the buildPayload return object. Suggested (all optional, fall through to server defaults if absent -- backend validators already enforce bounds):
  panel_size: source.panel_size || undefined,
  wrap_trim_width_in: source.wrap_trim_width_in ?? undefined,
  fascia_width_in: source.fascia_width_in ?? undefined,
  batten_spacing_in: source.batten_spacing_in ?? undefined,
  shake_reveal_in: source.shake_reveal_in ?? undefined,
  color_tier: source.color_tier || undefined,
  lp_soffit_type: source.lp_soffit_type || undefined,
Also confirm that after save, the frontend either receives the re-derived lines in the PUT response, or fires POST /api/estimates/{id}/lp-package/materialize so the LP tab visibly renames/recounts live (the review said 're-derives live'). Backend materialize is proven to do the rename+recount when called after PUT.

action_items: CRITICAL: Extend buildPayload in /app/frontend/src/lib/useEstimate.js to include panel_size, wrap_trim_width_in, fascia_width_in, batten_spacing_in (and shake_reveal_in, color_tier, lp_soffit_type while there -- same shape of bug).

After PUT of an LP trade-spec, fire POST /api/estimates/{est_id}/lp-package/materialize (or use the same 'apply' path the review references) so the LP tab visibly renames + recounts in the browser -- current PUT alone does not re-derive stored lines.

Once fixed, re-run the browser walkthrough: expect Jon Casile 38 Series to rename to 4' x 8' Panel and qty 68 -> ~84; 540 to rename to 5/4" x 6"; 440 to rename to 4/4" x 12"; and (F2 live proof) the .019 Coil row in 'Vinyl Soffit with Siding' to roughly double vs fascia=8 after the derivation runs.
critical_code_review_comments: buildPayload is a strict whitelist -- every new estimate-level field will silently strip until it's added there. Consider replacing the whitelist with a small deny-list ({kind, id, company_id, _id, created_at, updated_at, lp_source_run_id, ...}) so newly-shipped SettingsRow fields don't require a paired buildPayload edit. This is a recurring class of the exact bug Howard flagged 4 times.

SettingsRow.jsx wires each select directly to update({key:value}) but there is no shared 'trade-spec' contract enumerated in one place -- adding a lint/test that asserts buildPayload keys is a superset of the union of update({...}) keys emitted from SettingsRow would kill this bug class.
